title: Trump's arch gets a late-night green light. Will a judge stop construction?
content: The Trump administration has said it could begin construction immediately after Thursday's vote. All eyes are now on the federal judge who has been asked to block it.

title: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
content: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

title: These are the races in the House and Senate that haven't been called yet
content: Democrats are poised to have a strong majority in the upcoming Congress. The final numbers are still being determined. Here's where things stand in the races that are waiting to be called by the AP.

title: Melania Trump touts rare agreement she brokered between Russia and Ukraine
content: The six-day pause from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky comes as the administration ramps up efforts to secure an agreement to end the war in Ukraine.

title: How North Carolina Democrats flipped several House seats in historically GOP districts
content: All of these seats were in districts redrawn in 2023 to favor Republican candidates.

title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
content: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation, as the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

title: Head of Justice Department office on Civil Rights resigns
content: The head of the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division, Harmeet Dhillon, is out after 18 tumultuous months in charge.

title: Discursive Verses: Is 'Spend Dat' the best financial indicator of America's grift economy?
content: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: How Yung Miami's summer bop became a sweeping indictment.

title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
content: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
content: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.
